description: Incremental sync: what was ADDED or REMOVED since a timestamp. Use this — not repeated search_rounds calls — when you keep a local copy in step with the dataset. Sorted oldest-first by ingestion time, so `nextCursor` is resumable: store the last one and start there next run. Reports additions and removals only; the source tables have no modification timestamp, so a silent edit to an existing row is not reported (re-read that record by id when you need its current state). Exits are not available here — that table has no ingestion timestamp.

after.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous call

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

since.description: Start of the window: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the ISO timestamp your last sync ended at

name: list_changes
